title: LLM-Based Knowledge Graph Completion Combining Discrete Structural Coding with Similar Entity Information
abstract: arXiv:2608.30235v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Knowledge graph completion requires models to use both textual descriptions and relational structure. Existing LLM-based methods either encode KG structure as discrete tokens or refine a restricted set of candidate entities, and these two directions have largely been studied separately. We propose CoSC for LLM-based KGC, which combines discrete structural coding with similar entity information. Specifically, an LLM generates an initial candidate entity ranking from discrete structural codes, after which information from entities with structures similar to that of the query entity refines the ranking. Experiments on FB15k-237 show that CoSC outperforms existing baselines on MRR and Hits@10 while remaining competitive on Hits@1.

translated_title: 基于大语言模型的知识图谱补全：结合离散结构编码与相似实体信息
translated_abstract: 知识图谱补全需要模型同时利用文本描述和关系结构。现有的基于大语言模型（LLM）的方法要么将知识图谱结构编码为离散token，要么对受限的候选实体集合进行精炼，而这两个方向在很大程度上是分开研究的。我们提出了CoSC，一种基于LLM的知识图谱补全方法，它将离散结构编码与相似实体信息相结合。具体而言，LLM首先从离散结构代码生成初始的候选实体排序，随后利用与查询实体结构相似的实体信息对该排序进行细化。在FB15k-237数据集上的实验表明，CoSC在MRR和Hits@10指标上优于现有基线方法，同时在Hits@1上保持竞争力。
tldr: 提出CoSC方法，将离散结构编码与相似实体信息相结合用于基于大语言模型的知识图谱补全，先由LLM从离散结构代码生成初始候选实体排序，再利用结构相似实体的信息细化排序，在FB15k-237上于MRR和Hits@10指标上超越现有基线。
en_tdlr: CoSC combines discrete structural coding with similar entity information for LLM-based knowledge graph completion, where an LLM generates an initial candidate ranking from discrete structural codes that is then refined using information from structurally similar entities, outperforming existing baselines on MRR and Hits@10 on FB15k-237.
